title: Boreas Structure
physical_identity: Fun Zone activity palace: office-like Waiting halls (white concrete, brown carpet, vending and Almond Water) and the neon black Electric with game rooms; windows show a starry void.
scale_topology: Unknown extent; indoor halls; the Electric slopes imperceptibly downward; M.E.G. log claims it is a structure on a planet.
anomalies: orange gelatinous ooze falls from ceiling
windows show void and stars and chill 10 m radius
lighting_sound: Neon lighting in the Electric; hallucinated breathing and heavy winds; no other audio stated.

entities.name: Deathmoths, Clumps, Hounds, Facelings, Skin-Stealers, Nguithr'xurhs, Growlers
entities.behavior: minimal in Waiting halls, more in the Electric; repelled by game doors

entities.name: Wrangler
entities.behavior: manifested when Asteroid Blasters is lost

entities.name: Liquid Pain
entities.behavior: floods room when Rock Climbing lost

entities.name: Blue-flesh sky entity
entities.behavior: eyes and teeth, spits orange ooze (single testimony)

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Deathmoths, Clumps, Hounds, Facelings, Skin-Stealers, Nguithr'xurhs, Growlers, Wrangler, Liquid Pain; sky entity testimony only
hazards: cold to -27 C (-43 C near windows)
items_communities: no settlement; M.E.G. will not build an outpost

entrances.quote: Blue doors containing the words "FUN ZONE"
named "Fun Zone" will lead to Level 20

entrances.method: Look at sky in cold state
entrances.quote: has a chance of teleporting one to Level 20

exits.quote: staff-only doors within the Waiting halls, these will take you to Level 2
These doors will always have an exit sign nearby.
sent to either Level 7 or Level 154
guaranteed to send you to a dangerous level

signature_mechanic: Game doors in the Electric: win for supplies, lose for hostile manifestations or dangerous teleports; temperature falls as the halls slowly descend.
verticality: Only an imperceptible downward slope in the Electric.
do_not: treat planet/sky entity as confirmed article fact
conflicts_notes: Page says entities stop appearing past -27 yet logs report a Hound at -43 (log, testimony). Lasers game exits listed under 'If Won' column table. Last log is hallucination-affected.
